description: Found reviewing defk-6cn. Defk.Report.print on for i <- 0..(len(a) - 1)//1 do out[2 * i] = a[i] end over [u8] (no floats anywhere) shows 'loop: ...; flagged' and 'non-finite: float checks set a flag tested once per strip; a set flag replays the strip with raising checks'. Either the strip is marked flagged although it has no flagged helper (then the C pays a needless flag/replay path: check the generated C), or the report notes any flag_strip success. Done when the note appears only for loops whose strip actually contains a flagged operation, with a test, and the generated C for an integer-only loop has no replay path if it had one.
title: Fast-path report prints a non-finite flag note on loops with no float operations
